  confidence=5

The agents.d fragment documents this as a deliberate deviation, because the editor-input contract forbids reducing the bundle. Severity disagreement: gemini and luna rated it MAJOR, sonnet and minimax rated it NIT; the highest is MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash skipped this gap as a documented deviation.
